source.title: Ermes Gasparini on Devon and Vitaly 🤯
source.description:
The Gladiator speaks! 🇮🇹 Ermes Gasparini reveals the one armwrestling match he is watching closely at East vs West 22: The titan clash between Devon Larratt and Vitaly Laletin.
But the focus shifts to June. Ermes returns to the table to face Martin Morozov! 🇰🇿 No more games. From now on, it's all about calculated preparation:

🔥 Sharpening the Pronator
✊ Strengthening the Cup
💪 Unstoppable Side Pressure
Ermes vs Morozov... who takes the hand first?
 Let us know your prediction! 👇
